summary: Compare reserve products, procurement choices, settlement and cost allocation through power-pool scenarios. Explore the course outline.
lede: Ancillary-services training helps power-sector professionals link reliability needs to procurement and cost-allocation decisions. It is for electricity regulators, market-operator and power-pool staff, utility managers, and renewable-energy participants making market or system-operation choices. Participants learn to estimate reserves using N-1 contingencies, compare procurement options, interpret AGC and ACE concepts, and calculate illustrative balancing costs and settlements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape power-system reliability, ancillary-service market rules, procurement and settlement across utilities and interconnected power pools.
modules: Frequency Control with AGC and ACE
prerequisites: Working familiarity with electricity-sector operations, power markets or utility planning is recommended. No coding or programming is required; spreadsheet calculations can be completed in Excel or by hand.
